messages:
Alex: heads-up — we're going to run an automatic silo reshuffle in the next maintenance window (sat 03:00 UTC) to rebalance dedicated slices in us-west-2. observed persistent hot racks causing 99th p99 spikes for a handful of tenants.
Trina: what constraints do we need to respect? VPC egress pinned IPs? reserved AZ placement? :thinking_face:
Alex: yes. primary constraints: 1) tenants with static egress IP assignments can't move AZs without ip rotation work 2) dedicated pools with 'pin:az' tag remain in same AZ 3) some tenants have strict quota windows (billing/commit alignment)
Jay: any plan to avoid long cold kv-cache / slow warmups post-reshuffle? last time it spiked tail latencies for 30m.
Sophie: we should pre-warm by replaying hot prefixes into target slices and enable short TTL sticky cache. also schedule canary tenants first (5 small ones) then ramp.
Alex: agreed. high-level plan: pre-drain -> sync route table -> move allocations (shuffle) -> prefetch kvcache -> soft unseal -> metrics check -> full cutover. each step has 5m guard windows.
ops-bot: Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/silo-reshuffle (note: requires oncall sig-off)
Kevin: billing note: moving a tenant between dedicated slices can change cost attribution for that hour. finance asked us to emit a migration event to billing: 
```
POST /internal/billing/events
{ "tenant": "<id>", "event": "dedicated_move", "src_slice": "s1", "dst_slice": "s2", "ts": 1764444444 }
```
Trina: what about routing fallbacks? if target AZ has degraded NIC QoS we should fallback to a different slice in same AZ or cancel.
Jay: add a quick health probe before final cutover: sample 50 requests across KV hot prefixes, ensure p95 < 120ms and model steady-state token rate is within 10% of baseline.
Sophie: operational knobs: 1) disable auto-scaler for affected slices during shuffle 2) hold back burst lanes 3) pin prefetch threads to avoid CPU steal.
Alex: can someone own the pre-drain automation and the rollback hook? I can own the route table sync.
Trina: I'll take pre-drain automation and rollback hooks. will add feature flag:
```
FEATURE_FLAG=SILO_RESHUFFLE_AUTO_ROLLBACK=true
```
Kevin: i'll coordinate billing events and make sure finance can reconcile the hourly commit deltas.
ops-bot: scheduled: maintenance window created (ID: mw-2026-03-21-03-usw2). please add sig-off in thread before EOD fri.
Alex: OK — will post a short checklist for oncall and PMs. thanks all. :thumbsup:
Jay: quick ask — can we expose a test endpoint that simulates migration to validate KV warmup pattern? would save us a 2am surprise.
Sophie: yes, i'll prototype a replay tool this afternoon, will drop link in #devex when ready.
Alex: perfect. final note: keep reshuffle batch size <= 10 slices per min to limit blast radius. if metrics deviate we abort and roll back to source placement.
Trina: copying ops lead and PM. stopping autoscaling in staging now."
